assessment: This paper describes the derivation and validation of a coarse-grained model to measure mitochondrial metabolism at cellular and subcellular resolution by exploiting fluorescence lifetime imaging of NADH. This technique is applied to mouse oocytes subjected to a variety of metabolic stresses and to human tissue culture cells, revealing spatial gradients in mitochondrial NADH oxidation. This method represents an exciting new approach to quantifying mitochondrial electron transport chain rates and provides for the first time a method to study mitochondrial metabolic flux with subcellular resolution.
